deployment_contract.prediction_frequency: Once per completed daily sensor window.
deployment_contract.invalid_sensor_reading_rule: Discard a reading when temp == -1, hum == -1, either field is missing or non-numeric, or humidity is outside 0-100.
deployment_contract.location_rule: Use live GPS when available, otherwise the last valid GPS location, otherwise a sender-specific configured deployment coordinate. Snap that position to the nearest coordinate in training_grid before inference.

feature_definitions.temperature_mean_c: Mean of all valid DHT11 temperature readings in the completed daily window.
feature_definitions.temperature_max_c: Maximum valid DHT11 temperature in the completed daily window.
feature_definitions.relative_humidity: Mean of all valid DHT11 humidity readings in the completed daily window.
feature_definitions.dewpoint_c: Mean daily dew point calculated from each valid temperature-humidity reading.
feature_definitions.humidity_mean_3d: Mean of the latest three daily relative-humidity summaries.
feature_definitions.humidity_mean_7d: Mean of the latest seven daily relative-humidity summaries.
feature_definitions.temperature_mean_3d: Mean of the latest three daily mean-temperature summaries.
feature_definitions.temperature_mean_7d: Mean of the latest seven daily mean-temperature summaries.
feature_definitions.temperature_max_3d: Maximum of the latest three daily maximum temperatures.
feature_definitions.temperature_max_7d: Maximum of the latest seven daily maximum temperatures.
feature_definitions.dewpoint_mean_3d: Mean of the latest three daily dew-point summaries.
feature_definitions.dewpoint_mean_7d: Mean of the latest seven daily dew-point summaries.

deployment_contract.prediction_semantics: Predictive next-day regional hotspot risk. Flame and MQ2 alerts remain immediate and have higher operational priority.
